verses.original: Πρεσβυτέρῳ μὴ ἐπιπλήξῃς ἀλλὰ παρακάλει ὡς πατέρα νεωτέρους ὡς ἀδελφούς
verses.transliteration: Presbyterō mē epiplēxēs alla parakalei hōs patera neōterous hōs adelphous
verses.literal: Do not rebuke an older man but appeal to him as to a father Treat younger men as brothers
verses.literalPt: Não repreendas com aspereza ao velho; antes, exorta-o como a pai; aos moços, como a irmãos; às mulheres idosas, como a mães;

verses.original: πρεσβυτέρας ὡς μητέρας νεωτέρας ὡς ἀδελφὰς ἐν πάσῃ ἁγνείᾳ
verses.transliteration: presbyteras hōs mēteras neōteras hōs adelphas en pasē hagneia
verses.literal: older women as mothers and younger women as sisters with absolute purity
verses.literalPt: às moças, como a irmãs, com toda a pureza.

verses.original: Χήρας τίμα τὰς ὄντως χήρας
verses.transliteration: Chēras tima tas ontōs chēras
verses.literal: Honor the widows who are truly widows
verses.literalPt: Honra as viúvas que são verdadeiramente viúvas.

verses.original: εἰ δέ τις χήρα τέκνα ἢ ἔκγονα ἔχει μανθανέτωσαν πρῶτον τὸν ἴδιον οἶκον εὐσεβεῖν καὶ ἀμοιβὰς ἀποδιδόναι τοῖς προγόνοις τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ei de tis chēra tekna ē ekgona echei manthanetōsan prōton ton idion oikon eusebein kai amoibas apodidonai tois progonois touto gar estin apodekton enōpion tou Theou
verses.literal: But if a widow has children or grandchildren they must first learn . . . to show godliness to their own family and repay . . . their parents for this is pleasing in the sight of God
verses.literalPt: Mas, se alguma viúva tem filhos ou netos, que estes aprendam primeiro a exercer piedade para com sua própria família e a retribuir a seus pais o que deles receberam, porque isso é agradável diante de Deus.

verses.original: Ἡ δὲ ὄντως χήρα καὶ μεμονωμένη ἤλπικεν ἐπὶ Θεὸν καὶ προσμένει ταῖς δεήσεσιν καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: Hē de ontōs chēra kai memonōmenē ēlpiken epi Theon kai prosmenei tais deēsesin kai tais proseuchais nyktos kai hēmeras
verses.literal: The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers
verses.literalPt: Ora, aquela que é verdadeiramente viúva e desamparada espera em Deus e persevera, dia e noite, em súplicas e orações;

verses.original: ἡ δὲ σπαταλῶσα ζῶσα τέθνηκεν
verses.transliteration: hē de spatalōsa zōsa tethnēken
verses.literal: But she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she is still alive
verses.literalPt: ao passo que aquela que vive nos prazeres, apesar de viver, está morta.

verses.original: Καὶ ταῦτα παράγγελλε ἵνα ἀνεπίλημπτοι ὦσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai tauta parangelle hina anepilēmptoi ōsin
verses.literal: Give these instructions to the believers . . . so that they will be above reproach
verses.literalPt: Prescreve essas coisas, para que elas sejam irrepreensíveis.

verses.original: εἰ δέ τις τῶν ἰδίων καὶ μάλιστα οἰκείων οὐ προνοεῖ τὴν πίστιν ἤρνηται καὶ ἔστιν ἀπίστου χείρων
verses.transliteration: ei de tis tōn idiōn kai malista oikeiōn ou pronoei tēn pistin ērnētai kai estin apistou cheirōn
verses.literal: If anyone does not provide for his own and especially his own household he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever
verses.literalPt: Se alguém não cuida dos seus e especialmente dos de sua família, tem negado a fé e é pior que um incrédulo.

verses.original: Χήρα καταλεγέσθω μὴ ἔλαττον ἐτῶν ἑξήκοντα γεγονυῖα ἑνὸς ἀνδρὸς γυνή
verses.transliteration: Chēra katalegesthō mē elatton etōn hexēkonta gegonuia henos andros gynē
verses.literal: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old faithful . . . to her husband
verses.literalPt: Seja registrada como viúva somente aquela que não tem menos de sessenta anos e que há tido um só marido,

verses.original: ἐν ἔργοις καλοῖς μαρτυρουμένη εἰ ἐτεκνοτρόφησεν εἰ ἐξενοδόχησεν εἰ ἁγίων πόδας ἔνιψεν εἰ θλιβομένοις ἐπήρκεσεν εἰ παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ ἐπηκολούθησεν
verses.transliteration: en ergois kalois martyroumenē ei eteknotrophēsen ei exenodochēsen ei hagiōn podas enipsen ei thlibomenois epērkesen ei panti ergō agathō epēkolouthēsen
verses.literal: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children entertaining strangers washing the feet of the saints imparting relief to the afflicted and devoting herself to every good work
verses.literalPt: aprovada com testemunho de boas obras, se educou filhos, se exercitou a hospitalidade, se lavou os pés dos santos, se socorreu os atribulados e se praticou toda a sorte de boas obras.

verses.original: Νεωτέρας δὲ χήρας παραιτοῦ ὅταν γὰρ καταστρηνιάσωσιν τοῦ Χριστοῦ γαμεῖν θέλουσιν
verses.transliteration: Neōteras de chēras paraitou hotan gar katastrēniasōsin tou Christou gamein thelousin
verses.literal: But refuse to enroll younger widows For when their passions draw them away from Christ they will want to marry
verses.literalPt: Mas rejeita viúvas moças, porque, quando se tiverem tornado inquietas sob o jugo de Cristo, querem casar-se

verses.original: ἔχουσαι κρίμα ὅτι τὴν πρώτην πίστιν ἠθέτησαν
verses.transliteration: echousai krima hoti tēn prōtēn pistin ēthetēsan
verses.literal: and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith
verses.literalPt: e são culpadas, porque violaram a primeira promessa.

verses.original: ἅμα δὲ καὶ ἀργαὶ μανθάνουσιν περιερχόμεναι τὰς οἰκίας οὐ μόνον δὲ ἀργαὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ φλύαροι καὶ περίεργοι λαλοῦσαι τὰ μὴ δέοντα
verses.transliteration: hama de kai argai manthanousin perierchomenai tas oikias ou monon de argai alla kai phlyaroi kai periergoi lalousai ta mē deonta
verses.literal: At the same time they will also learn to be idle going from house to house and being not only idle but also gossips and busybodies discussing things they should not mention
verses.literalPt: Além disso, aprendem a ser ociosas, andando de casa em casa; e não somente ociosas, mas também faladeiras e intrigantes, falando o que não devem.

verses.original: Βούλομαι οὖν νεωτέρας γαμεῖν τεκνογονεῖν οἰκοδεσποτεῖν μηδεμίαν ἀφορμὴν διδόναι τῷ ἀντικειμένῳ λοιδορίας χάριν
verses.transliteration: Boulomai oun neōteras gamein teknogonein oikodespotein mēdemian aphormēn didonai tō antikeimenō loidorias charin
verses.literal: So I advise the younger widows to marry have children and manage their households denying . . . the adversary occasion for slander
verses.literalPt: Quero, pois, que as viúvas moças se casem, que tenham filhos, que dirijam a sua casa e que não deem ocasião ao adversário de dizer mal.

verses.original: ἤδη γάρ τινες ἐξετράπησαν ὀπίσω τοῦ Σατανᾶ
verses.transliteration: ēdē gar tines exetrapēsan opisō tou Satana
verses.literal: For some have already turned aside to follow Satan
verses.literalPt: Pois algumas já se desviaram para seguir a Satanás.

verses.original: Εἴ τις πιστὴ ἔχει χήρας ἐπαρκείτω αὐταῖς καὶ μὴ βαρείσθω ἡ ἐκκλησία ἵνα ταῖς ὄντως χήραις ἐπαρκέσῃ
verses.transliteration: Ei tis pistē echei chēras eparkeitō autais kai mē bareisthō hē ekklēsia hina tais ontōs chērais eparkesē
verses.literal: If any believing woman has dependent widows she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened so that it can help the widows who are truly in need
verses.literalPt: Se alguma mulher crente tem viúvas, mantenha-as, e não seja gravada a igreja, para que esta possa aliviar as que são verdadeiramente viúvas.

verses.original: Οἱ καλῶς προεστῶτες πρεσβύτεροι διπλῆς τιμῆς ἀξιούσθωσαν μάλιστα οἱ κοπιῶντες ἐν λόγῳ καὶ διδασκαλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hoi kalōs proestōtes presbyteroi diplēs timēs axiousthōsan malista hoi kopiōntes en logō kai didaskalia
verses.literal: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching
verses.literalPt: Os presbíteros que cumprem bem com os seus deveres sejam tidos por dignos de dobrada honra, especialmente os que se ocupam na pregação e no ensino.

verses.original: λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφή Βοῦν ἀλοῶντα οὐ φιμώσεις καί Ἄξιος ὁ ἐργάτης τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: legei gar hē graphē Boun aloōnta ou phimōseis kai Axios ho ergatēs tou misthou autou
verses.literal: For the Scripture says Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain and The worker is worthy of his wages
verses.literalPt: Pois a Escritura diz: Não ligarás a boca ao boi quando debulha, e: Digno é o trabalhador do seu salário.

verses.original: Κατὰ πρεσβυτέρου κατηγορίαν μὴ παραδέχου ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ ἐπὶ δύο ἢ τριῶν μαρτύρων
verses.transliteration: Kata presbyterou katēgorian mē paradechou ektos ei mē epi dyo ē triōn martyrōn
verses.literal: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder except . . . . . . on the testimony of two or three witnesses
verses.literalPt: Não recebas acusação contra um presbítero, senão pela boca de duas ou três testemunhas.

verses.original: Τοὺς δὲ ἁμαρτάνοντας ἐνώπιον πάντων ἔλεγχε ἵνα καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ φόβον ἔχωσιν
verses.transliteration: Tous de hamartanontas enōpion pantōn elenche hina kai hoi loipoi phobon echōsin
verses.literal: But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone so that the others will stand in fear of sin
verses.literalPt: Aos que pecam, repreende-os diante de todos, para que também os outros tenham medo.

verses.original: Διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν ἀγγέλων ἵνα ταῦτα φυλάξῃς χωρὶς προκρίματος μηδὲν ποιῶν κατὰ πρόσκλισιν
verses.transliteration: Diamartyromai enōpion tou Theou kai Christou Iēsou kai tōn eklektōn angelōn hina tauta phylaxēs chōris prokrimatos mēden poiōn kata prosklisin
verses.literal: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias and to do nothing out of partiality
verses.literalPt: Eu te conjuro, diante de Deus, e de Jesus Cristo, e dos anjos escolhidos, que guardes esses conselhos sem prevenção, nada fazendo com espírito de parcialidade.

verses.original: Χεῖρας ταχέως μηδενὶ ἐπιτίθει μηδὲ κοινώνει ἁμαρτίαις ἀλλοτρίαις σεαυτὸν ἁγνὸν τήρει
verses.transliteration: Cheiras tacheōs mēdeni epitithei mēde koinōnei hamartiais allotriais seauton hagnon tērei
verses.literal: Do not be too quick . . . in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others Keep yourself pure
verses.literalPt: A ninguém imponhas as mãos precipitadamente, nem participes dos pecados de outrem; conserva-te a ti mesmo puro.

verses.original: Μηκέτι ὑδροπότει ἀλλὰ οἴνῳ ὀλίγῳ χρῶ διὰ τὸν στόμαχον καὶ τὰς πυκνάς σου ἀσθενείας
verses.transliteration: Mēketi hydropotei alla oinō oligō chrō dia ton stomachon kai tas pyknas sou astheneias
verses.literal: Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead because of your stomach and your frequent ailments
verses.literalPt: Não bebas mais água só, mas usa de um pouco de vinho, por causa do teu estômago e das tuas frequentes indisposições.

verses.original: Τινῶν ἀνθρώπων αἱ ἁμαρτίαι πρόδηλοί εἰσιν προάγουσαι εἰς κρίσιν τισὶν δὲ καὶ ἐπακολουθοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: Tinōn anthrōpōn hai hamartiai prodēloi eisin proagousai eis krisin tisin de kai epakolouthousin
verses.literal: The sins of some men are obvious going ahead of them to judgment but the sins of others do not surface until later
verses.literalPt: Os pecados de alguns homens são notórios e precedem ao juízo, ao passo que, quanto a outros, só depois deste se manifestam;

verses.original: ὡσαύτως καὶ τὰ ἔργα τὰ καλὰ πρόδηλα καὶ τὰ ἄλλως ἔχοντα κρυβῆναι οὐ δύνανται
verses.transliteration: hōsautōs kai ta erga ta kala prodēla kai ta allōs echonta krybēnai ou dynantai
verses.literal: In the same way . . . good deeds are obvious and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden
verses.literalPt: do mesmo modo, há boas obras que são manifestas; e aquelas que não o são não podem ficar escondidas.
